title: Install Slopsentral - Slopsentral
text:
Start
Install Slopsentral

Add the marketplace and select plugins in Codex or GitHub Copilot CLI.

Use the plugin commands in your installed agent application. The examples install Software Engineering and Kotlin Engineering. For prose alone, substitute repository-knowledge@slopsentral.
These commands change the application’s marketplace and plugin configuration. They do not need a Slopsentral checkout.
​
Codex
Examine the configured marketplaces.
codex plugin marketplace list --json

If Slopsentral is absent, add its Codex branch.
codex plugin marketplace add amichne/slopsentral --ref harness/codex --json

Install the selected plugins.
codex plugin add software-engineering@slopsentral --json
codex plugin add kotlin-engineering@slopsentral --json

Examine the installed plugins.
codex plugin list --json

The inventory must list the selected plugin identities. If an existing source points elsewhere, examine it before replacement. The OpenAI documentation describes marketplace sources and Git refs.
​
GitHub Copilot CLI
Examine the configured marketplaces.
copilot plugin marketplace list

If Slopsentral is absent, add its GitHub Copilot branch.
copilot plugin marketplace add 'amichne/slopsentral#harness/github-copilot'

Install the selected plugins.
copilot plugin install software-engineering@slopsentral
copilot plugin install kotlin-engineering@slopsentral

Examine the installed plugins.
copilot plugin list

The GitHub reference describes plugin selectors and marketplace refs.
​
Use the installation
Start a fresh agent session. State the task and the authorized scope. If the host asks for hook trust, examine the selected hook before approval.
For Kotlin semantic tools, examine Kast’s connection separately. Kast owns its runtime and workspace discovery. A plugin inventory does not prove that a workspace accepts semantic queries.
The workflow profiles declare the provider branches. The troubleshooting guide covers missing capabilities and stale installations.
